newsitem.title: CHINA: China Meiling makes A share rights issue.
newsitem.headline: China Meiling makes A share rights issue.

text.p: Chinese refrigerator maker Hefei Meiling Co Ltd said on Wednesday it would make a 2.22-for-10 rights issue to its domestic currency A share holders.
The rights shares will be priced at 4.80 yuan each, Meiling said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
Meling's A shares were trading at 9.39 yuan on Wednesday morning.
The company did not give a timetable for the offer.
Meiling has a total of 380.23 million shares, composed of 175.22 million non-listed state and institutional shares, 113.10 million foreign currency B shares and 91.91 million A shares.
Meiling's net profit for 1996 was 138.3 million yuan, up from 95.1 million yuan in 1995 based on international accounting standards.
